body:
I'm starting looking at all the chemicals I've listed and ingested to report my experience (Methadone 60 mg, AMT 2 Mg, 1 Xanax and a Blunt later 7 Ho mytraginine (alkaloid opioïd of the plant Kratom) and few lines of MPPP [4'-methyl-α-PPP]. Ouch!!! Over a period of 6 Hours. And I think now as my sedated heart is bumping in my chest : 'Shit you're fucked up so bad that you forget the after effect of the lunch earlier today man'
4-MeMABP + Ethylphenidate at very precise dosage for perfect dynamic euphoria but it's another report...But I guess it matters.
Woooow I feel so good now, I'd like to share the warm euphoria glow and the dopamine waves with my lady but she's with our son and there will be a time for that later. I must enjoy my success and the very rich intoxication I'm riding for few hours as a man sleeping near the fire and he likes it so much in the cold winter of December he keeps feeding it with respect for its comforting qualities. Now I know I've reached a level of knowledge of a wide variety of substances and it's good to know that it's approaching perfection again in dosage of several treats with great material and experience in accurate taste for natural highs and chemicals. I know it's easy to cross the border of my limits because I almost  killed myself in an Etizolam / DOC horror interaction, I say that because now there is potent chems available like DOC or 3 Meo PCP, and once you've passed the point of pleasure, and enter the fiend state of moreish you can easily forget how things get done and that a difference of one or two milligrams is a giant wormhole where you could disappear forever.
So I know I have tonight the ingredients for a thing that a good number of psychonauts love : Speedball. And I'm in it now, a very special one, I feel the calm from methadone daily use allowing me to feel the weird synergy of 1 Pill of Xanax drinked with a good amount of 7 Hydroxymytragynine while smoking a blunt had my opioïd receptors excited and my body loaded with a warm buzz glowing in the tryptamine light effect of 2 mg of pure AMT.
I watch A cartoon master shake is perfect in his new adventures while cannabis makes his work on opioïd activity like it's often the case with good old weed and Heroin for example.
All began to feel very blurry and slow, I think of finishing a song I started, I think of my rock of MPPP in my desk...Shit I can't shake the idea of it being too much but I know I've been cool on every dose (but the Methadone, 60 mg is too much and if I could I would stop this Hypocrites treatments in the whole world and Ive got lots of better ideas believe me).
Anyway, now the MPPP is up and my heart beat is going hardcore I know its a bit too speedy but I'm thinking that I need to wait for the speedball effect to finish the initial rush I'm experiencing now and after I will be able to enjoy the ride even more.
I sincerely hope I'm not playing too much, the speedball effect is harder than usual coke / heroin mix for sure, but I feel so good at the same time, pain is far far away tonight and I feel free as I know methadone will be over soon, I've discovered too many great things to be a corporate pharma laboratories addict and profit as good as dead meat for lots of very poor mental plasticity kind of people...I don't urge you to try my mix even if you shouldn't be planning this, but if you do so, please start lower, I've been in trial for this particular mix for two weeks testing everything on its own and at minimal amount, and waiting few days in between.
NOTE: It's been a year now since I'm in a Methadone program, after jailtime started recovery from hard poly-toxic substances abuse at dangerous levels everyday for past 7 years, Opiates & Ketamine included...and often taken in the same line.
The ease I've ever felt through extreme mental experience and physical limits in the optimistic perspective that everything happens because you let it happen in a way that always made me faithful even in the worst case overdose scenarios.
[Reported Doses: ''60 mg Methadone, 2 mg AMT, 100 mg MPPP, 2 g Cannabis, 0.25 mg Alprazolam & 40 drop pure alkaloid 7-Hydroxymitragynine'']
